note: The `vyre ...` parser. Ported from local/capsule/native/Sources/Host/CommandRun.swift (CLIRun.parse, .forCapsule, .refused) and Tests/CommandRunTests.swift.

cases.note: the bare word alone is not a command
vyre must open the line, not just appear in it
vyred (the daemon) is not the same word as vyre (the CLI)
bare `vyre voice` is the terminal's push-to-talk; in the Capsule talking is Option-Return, so it shows voice's status instead

cases.expect: This is the Capsule already. Its settings are in the menu bar mark.
To talk to a session from here, pick it with @ and press Option-Return.

cases.note: an ordinary verb is not refused
